_readme: TMP_009 iteration 2 spike — same fixture (1 entry × 3 biomes × 3 seeds) as nag-cfg1.0-bush-spike-pack but routed through the `flux1-dev-q8-tree-nag-upscale` alias which chains 2x-AnimeSharpV4 image upscale + lanczos downsample after VAEDecode. Goal: lift the soft/blurry character of the baseline NAG outputs without touching the gen-time chain (NAG params + LoRA + prompt all identical to baseline). A/B target: baseline 2026-05-23 entry in experiments/tmp_009/REVIEW.md.
